description: USE WHEN you want one citable record of the diagnostics you ran, with their gate flags. Every enveloped response is recorded by request_id. Give request_ids from your own responses (compiled chronologically) or last_n for your own most recent entries (API token required). Returns the entries with their gate signals (revision_required + grounding_summary) and a ready-to-cite markdown document; the dossier's own revision_required is true when any listed entry carried a gate flag (it does not know whether you later revised). One entry's full payload and call manifest: get_run. A factual record, never advisory.

last_n.description: Alternatively: compile your N most recent entries, 1 or more. Needs an API token; anonymous callers use request_ids. Ignored when request_ids is given.
last_n.title: Last N

request_ids.description: Explicit request_ids to compile chronologically (take them from previous responses' request_id fields).
request_ids.title: Request Ids

name: get_dossier
title: Get dossier (audit trail of past diagnostics)
